observation: Sampling each negative at the positive disease's training degree (nearest-degree fallback) gives 12,230 pairs, 9,916 unique negatives and an 18.92% base rate, with 5,121 of 11,570 test negatives exactly matched (44.26%). Histogram base scored 0.289355/0.286595, HPO+STRING 0.300289/0.261905 and disease degree 0.271237/0.248203; F-0031 makes this the main robustness test.
subject: F-39
title: Degree-matched negatives leave little signal above degree
